text_blocks.snippet: Tamoxifen is not a chemotherapy drug. It is a hormonal therapy medication used to treat hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
snippet_highlighted_words: Tamoxifen is not a chemotherapy drug

text_blocks.snippet: Tamoxifen works by blocking the effects of estrogen in breast cancer cells. This helps to slow down the growth of the cancer and prevent it from spreading.

Tamoxifen is typically used in combination with other treatments, such as surgery and chemotherapy, for the treatment of breast cancer. It may also be used as a preventive measure in women who are at high risk of developing breast cancer.
